--- title: "Week 3: Time series decomposition" --- ::: {.cell} :::
Week 3

Break time series into interpretable components so trend, seasonality, and remainder can be analysed separately.

Prepare before class

Read Chapter 3 of FPP3 and come in ready to distinguish trend-cycle, seasonal, and remainder components.

Seminar and workshop

Wednesday 18 March · Seminar 3:00pm to 3:50pm, workshop 4:00pm to 4:50pm · Building K Level 3, K321

Focus
  • Transformations that stabilise variation
  • Decomposition into trend-cycle, seasonal, and remainder parts
  • Seasonal adjustment
Assessment

Week 3 quiz on Wednesday 18 March

## What you will learn this week * Transforming data to remove some sources of variation * Decomposing a time series into trend-cycle, seasonal and remainder components * Seasonal adjustment ## Pre-class activities Read [Chapter 3 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/decomposition.html) and watch all embedded videos ## Slides for seminar Download pdf ## Seminar Code ::: {.callout appearance="minimal"} [week3-code.R](week3-code.R){download="week3-code.R"} ::: ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives 1. **Visualise and assess time series transformations**. - Create appropriate graphs for multiple time series and apply transformations when needed. 2. **Evaluate the usefulness Box–Cox transformations**. - Able to explain when and why a Box–Cox transformation is or is not helpful for a given dataset. 3. **Apply time series decomposition techniques**. - Able to decompose a time series into trend, seasonal, and remainder components using STL decomposition and interpret the results. ::: - Complete Exercise 2, 3, 10 from [Section 3.7](https://otexts.com/fpp3/decomposition-exercises.html) of the book. - [Week 3 Tutorial Solution.html](Tutorial3Solution.html){download="Tutorial3Solution.html"} ## Assignments * [GA1](../assignments/G1.qmd) is due on Tuesday 24 March. * [IA2](../assignments/A2.qmd) is due on Thursday 02 April. ## Weekly quiz * Week 3 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5399994) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400159) — Due Wednesday 18 March.
